okta_system_log._note: Simplified model of the Okta System Log (Okta Identity Engine) and Okta's help and support resources. Event types and outcome values follow Okta's System Log event shape; the field list is a subset.

group_add.label: added the user to the group

app_assign.label: assigned the app to the user

OKTA_STATUS_PAGE.use_for: Service-wide incidents and maintenance: check it first, subscribe to updates, follow the incident until it is resolved.

OKTA_HELP_CENTER.where: help.okta.com (product documentation) and the Okta Help Center knowledge base at support.okta.com
OKTA_HELP_CENTER.use_for: How-to and configuration questions: product documentation and knowledge base articles.

OKTA_COMMUNITY.where: Okta Community and Okta Ideas, reached from the Okta Help Center
OKTA_COMMUNITY.use_for: Feature ideas (posted to Okta Ideas, where others vote) and peer discussion of best practices.

SUPPORT_CASE.where: Open a case from the Okta Help Center (support.okta.com) or the Admin Console Help menu
SUPPORT_CASE.use_for: A problem in YOUR org: a bug, an outage that the status page does not show, or a security incident.

case_field_labels.org_id: Okta org ID and org URL (for example example.okta.com)
case_field_labels.system_log_evidence: System Log evidence: event uuids or transaction IDs, the filter used, exported events
case_field_labels.impact: business impact: how many users, which apps, production or preview org
case_field_labels.steps_to_reproduce: steps to reproduce, expected versus actual result, screenshots or HAR file
case_field_labels.affected_users: affected users or groups and whether every user is affected
case_field_labels.containment_done: containment already taken (sessions cleared, token revoked, admin suspended)

severity._note: Generic severity labels; check Okta's current support case priority definitions in the Okta Help Center.

concepts.System Log: Okta's record of every org event (sign-ins, admin changes, provisioning, policy decisions), searchable in the Admin Console and through the System Log API.
concepts.eventType: The dotted name of what happened in an event, such as user.session.start or group.user_membership.add.
concepts.actor: Who or what performed the action in an event: a user, an admin, an app or Okta itself.
concepts.target: The list of objects an event acted on, such as the user, the group and the app instance.
concepts.outcome: The result of an event (SUCCESS, FAILURE, ALLOW, DENY and others) with an optional reason explaining a failure.
concepts.filter expression: A query such as eventType eq "user.account.lock" and outcome.result eq "SUCCESS" that narrows the System Log to matching events.
concepts.status.okta.com: Okta's public service status page, which shows service-wide incidents and planned maintenance.
concepts.org ID: The unique identifier of an Okta org, which Okta Support needs to find your tenant.

finding_definitions.NOT_ASSIGNED_TO_APP: No current assignment of the app to the user, directly or through a group, appears in the log.
finding_definitions.PROVISIONING_FAILED: The app is assigned, but pushing the user's account to the app failed.
finding_definitions.DENIED_BY_POLICY: A sign-on (authentication) policy evaluation denied access to the app.
finding_definitions.LOCKED_OUT: The account was locked after too many failed sign-in attempts.
finding_definitions.USER_DEACTIVATED: The user is deactivated or suspended, so no app can be opened.
finding_definitions.CHANGE_BY_ADMIN: A successful change event names the actor who made the change.
finding_definitions.NO_EVIDENCE: No event in the log explains the ticket: widen the search or escalate, never close it as fixed.
